comment: A bar swing parameter and a bar swing CV input are declared but given no widget, because the bar has no off-beats to swing; neither can be reached on the panel. Swing settings are latched at the end of each bar rather than applied at once, so a moving swing CV cannot cut a pulse short mid-bar. With an external clock patched, the module phase-locks rather than merely following the tempo, re-anchoring the grid at every downbeat.
